qt: to the Commission Patrick Breyer (Verts/ALE) Subject:

With regard to the public consultation by Coimisiún na Meán, Ireland, on the Online Safety Code1 and, more specifically, on the envisaged ‘effective age verification measures’ for video-sharing platform services and providers (point 11.16 of the consultation document), as well as ‘robust age verification’ measures on specific platforms (point 11.19 of the consultation document), is it in line with EU law that national law mandates age verification for video-sharing platform services and providers as described above?
at: (English version) to the Commission Patrick Breyer (Verts/ALE) (4 April 2024) Subject: National age verification requirements imposed on video-sharing platforms With regard to the public consultation by Coimisiún na Meán, Ireland, on the Online Safety Code (1) and, more specifically, on the envisaged ‘effective age verification measures’ for video-sharing platform services and providers (point 11.16 of the consultation document), as well as ‘robust age verification’ measures on specific platforms (point 11.19 of the consultation document), is it in line with EU law that national law mandates age verification for video-sharing platform services and providers as described above? (31 May 2024) To date, Ireland has not notified to the Commission any provisions of the Online Safety Code (2) under the Single Market Transparency Directive (EU) 2015/1535 (3). In the absence of such notifications or its formal adoption, the Commission cannot formally assess the Online Safety Code and conclude on its compatibility with Union law.
